details.name: Determining Whether One is a Teenager (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that receives a string that has the user name and age separated by a colon, and prints whether the user is a teenager. Make sure that the program handles all possible exceptions.

details.name: Determining Whether One is a Teenager (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that asks the user to enter a string that has the user name and age separated by a colon, and prints whether the user is a teenager. Make sure that the program handles all possible exceptions. The program must ask the user for an input until the user enters a string that could be processed without any exception.
